title: freshness-witness
description: PROPOSED (RoT-1 revision 4). Freshness witness statement (payloadType freshness-witness.v1, purpose freshness-witness; KS-11: the purpose shares a key with no other purpose). It asserts only that, as of issued_at, the latest Trust State Statement of the lineage is (sequence, statement_digest). It names an existing TSS digest and can introduce, remove or reorder no state (24 §3.3). A witness is honoured only for the effective TSS it names, within witness_max_validity_hours, not issued in the future beyond the compiled skew, and never older than the newest witness the verifier has accepted. C3 and binary acceptance need at least two distinct witness keys (compiled minimum).
